name: South Jersey Speedsolving 2024

venue.name: Fellowship Community Church, Mount Laurel Campus
venue.address: 1520 Hainesport Rd, Mt Laurel Township, NJ 08054

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Information tab.

Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue.
